==Biography==
Marcel "'''dexter'''" Feldkamp is a professional League of Legends player hailing from Germany. He was exposed to gaming very early in his life, and the first game he recalls playing was Final Fantasy.
At age 14, he started playing Counter-Strike on a competitive level in Germany. Three years later, he switched focus to World of WarCraft and reached a peak rating of 2950 in Arena. During his WoW days, he while also part of a top 50 guild he made with his friends.

Feldkamp was introduced to League of Legends by a friend who used to play DOTA competitively but switched to LoL. Noticing the lack of Jungle mains, he went on to specialize in the role late into Season One.

===Competitive History===
Like many professional players, Dexter's skill was recognized by others while playing at a high Solo Queue level. He made his first competitive team alongside [[foo sharp]] and [[Kikis]] in February of 2013, competing under the name [[Dexter is actually evil]] till the end of the Summer Split Promotion tournament.

Following [[Malunoo]]'s two-week benching during the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/Europe/Season_3/Spring_Round_Robin|Season 3 Spring Split]], Dexter played for the [[DragonBorns]] in Weeks 6 and 7. Dexter's performance during the 2013 Summer Promotion Tournament incited newly promoted [[Sinners Never Sleep]] (later [[Lemondogs]]) to hire him as the starting Jungler in June 2013. In the Summer Season, he and [[Nukeduck]] developped high levels of synergy and clinched first place in the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/Europe/Season_3/Summer_Round_Robin|Split's Round Robin phase]], then second place in the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/Europe/Season_3/Summer_Playoffs|Summer Playoffs]], qualifying to the [[Season 3 World Championship]] in the process. Following a World Championship Group Stage exit, the Lemondogs parted ways, and Dexter sought a new home.

Prior to the end of 2013, [[Counter Logic Gaming]] signed Dexter for the [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/2014_Season/Spring_Playoffs|2014 Season Spring]] and [[Riot_League_Championship_Series/North_America/2014_Season/Summer_Playoffs|Summer Splits.]] With him in tow, the team asserted itself as a legitimate threat in the NA LCS, narrowly losing to [[Team SoloMid]] in the Spring Playoffs. The team followed it up with a strong Summer Split start, before experiencing a dip in performance that lasted through the Playoffs, culminating in a sixth place finish. Dexter played his last games under the CLG banner during the team's 3-2 victory over [[Curse Academy]], then left the team citing environment issues.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/dexter1lol/posts/394661287351427 Dexter's Post about Departure from CLG] - Facebook</ref>

====2015 Season====
In March, dexter and [[Tabzz]] joined [[Elements]] as substitutes, though they didn't start in any games in the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Spring Season|Spring Split]].<ref>[http://www.thescoreesports.com/lol/news/789 Elements adds Dexter as a sub, owner says that he will not be playing this week] ''thescoreesports.com''</ref> 

However, prior to the start of the [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Summer Season|Summer Split]], both of them moved to starting positions, while [[Jwaow]] and [[promisQ]] joined the team; only [[Froggen]] remained on the starting roster.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/Elementsgg/posts/726955550749046 Elements' Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref> The [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2015 Season/Summer Season|Summer Split]] was disappointing for the team, again finishing in 7th place, though this meant that they would still have a place in next season's [[Riot League Championship Series/Europe/2016 Season/Spring Season|Spring Split]].
=== 2016 Season ===
While remaining on the Elements lineup as a substitute, Dexter began to do freelance work for '''theScore Esports''', working as an interviewer. He continued to be listed as a substitute when [[FC Schalke 04]] acquired the Elements roster and LCS seed.
== Trivia ==
* Was known for his {{ci|Lee Sin}} during Season 2, when he would frequently get flamed for being a "bruiser-abuser".
:* Would also warrant {{ci|Jarvan IV}} bans when he joined [[Dragonborns]], having played him for a very long time.
* Before he played League of Legends professionally, Dexter wanted to pursue a career in programming and planned on studying Computer Science if professional League of Legends didn't work out.
* The team name '''"dexter is actually evil"''' was mostly an inside joke within the team, which he formed with [[foo sharp]] and [[Leduck]]. They had a second roster called '''"kikis is actually stupid"''', but the Dexter-named roster was the one that eventually reached Challenger, at one point even placing second.
* Is an avid TV show viewer, with [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0944947/ Game of Thrones] and [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt1632701/ Suits] being his favorites.
* Is fond of spicy food, taking a liking to Chinese and Oriental (Middle East) cuisine.
* One of the books he would like to read is "A Song of Ice and Fire".
* Favorite movies include [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0137523/?ref_=sr_1 Fight Club], [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0407887/ The Departed] and [http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0110912/ Pulp Fiction].
* During his transition period to join [[Counter Logic Gaming]], Dexter had to spend a night in jail. Once he was released he was sent back to his home country for holding an incompetent visa and was regarded as a traveler attempting to immigrate to the USA illegally.
